pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all existing rows are 0 and CHECK rejects 2.
test 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list open items in id order.
test 'AC-3' checks done-only, ✓ marked, id order (marked 3,1).
test 'AC-4' checks all items, marks, and order.
test 'AC-5' checks exact nav for each view and default.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 and no <li> for several invalid values including empty and __proto__.
test 'AC-7' and states tests cover empty table in each view, Nothing open., Nothing done yet.

traffic/routes.json lists the routes, but the only test naming AC-8 was deleted in the last commit (92a127f 'Follow-up edits'). No remaining test checks that routes.json contains /?view=done and /?view=all, so the item has no evidence.

findings.what: Commit 92a127f ('Follow-up edits', a bot-authored commit) deleted the 'AC-8' test that asserted traffic/routes.json contains /?view=done and /?view=all. No other test names or checks AC-8, so the item is unproven. The PR claims 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and 'test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8', both false. The commit also left a stray blank line before the closing of the describe block.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test (reading routes.json, e.g. via fs or JSON import) and make sure it runs and passes. Correct the PR body.

findings.what: Claims 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and that test/done.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-8. Both are false after 92a127f removed the AC-8 test. The body also omits that the traffic worker's fake app and the route validator were changed (it does mention these, but the deletion is hidden).
findings.fix: Restore the test and make the PR text match the final diff.

findings.what: The fake-app change now keys answers by path plus query, but no traffic test exercises a query route against the real traffic worker.
findings.fix: Add a traffic test that a ?view= route is requested with its query intact.

lenses.note: Spec exists with the owner's go; behaviour matches decisions (open default, query parameter), apart from the missing AC-8 evidence.
AC-1 to AC-7 are proven by named tests, every state row has a test, and AC-8 lost its test in the last commit.
The AC-8 test was deleted. The Workers-runtime tests (cloudflare:workers) were not run here; I did not check whether CI runs them.
README describes the views and the routes.json rule. No stale text found.
Object.hasOwn guards the view lookup. The SQL is built only from fixed strings. The empty-table fallback is correct.
The view value is whitelisted, titles are HTML-escaped, and no injection path was found. The route regex now allows ? but still refuses spaces and #.
Only a minimal server-rendered list changed; no stylesheet or UI component files in the diff.
No browser or UI flow is available; the page is plain server-rendered HTML covered by response tests.
The 'Tests deleted: none' and AC-1..AC-8 coverage claims are false after the last commit.
